product_one_liner.value: SalesMail combines personalized video outreach and on-site tour intelligence for senior-living and home-care sales teams, helping them build trust, book more tours and assessments, and improve follow-up.

pricing_page.notes: The /pricing page is a request-a-demo form and does not present public plan pricing.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows one sales-oriented advice post, not an engineering or technical blog.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base links to multiple help and product-information sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles shown are Client Success Specialist, Product Manager, and Demand Generation Specialist; none is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: Amazon Transcribe (AWS) for transcription and speaker separation, and Anthropic Claude API for summaries, coaching, and follow-up content.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 as in progress, which is not a completed certification; it names no other listed certification.

last_funding.notes: The profile lists this as the most recent financing.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent financing listed is dated 2020-05, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open roles listed are not SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail announced the Sidekick launch on 2026-09-16, within the six-month period ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The listed C-level/VP leaders’ start dates are before 2025-11-09. Joe Stephens joined as Head of Finance in 2026, but the company announcement does not give him a C-level or VP title and says he had already worked with SalesMail as a fractional CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Integration pages name the supported systems; a current demand-generation posting also references Zoho CRM.
